'''Domantas Sabonis''' (born May 3, 1996) is a Lithuanian [[basketball]] player who most recently played college basketball for [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga University]] from 2014 to 2016. He previously played in Spain for [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja Málaga]]'s junior and senior teams, although he never signed a professional contract. He is the son of the Lithuanian basketball player [[Arvydas Sabonis]], and was born in [[Portland, Oregon]] while his father was playing for the [[Portland Trail Blazers]]. Domantas wears the number 11 just like his father.

==Professional career==
Despite being only a 16-year-old, on September 5, 2012 he debuted in the main [[Unicaja Málaga]] team during the game against [[Cibona Zagreb]].<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-53417-sabonis-debiutavo-unicaja-komandoje.html Domantas Sabonis debuted in Unicaja main team] {{lt icon}}</ref> However he was loaned to [[CB Axarquía|Clínicas Rincón]] for the 2012–13 season. He was recalled in 2013. Domantas never  signed a professional contract with salary because he wished to  remain eligible for the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]].<ref>[http://www.15min.lt/naujiena/sportas/krepsinis/domantas-sabonis-prisijungs-prie-pagrindines-unicaja-komandos-23-359169 Domantas Sabonis joins main Unicaja roster] {{lt icon}}</ref> On October 13, 2013, he debuted in [[Liga ACB|ACB]] league as a Unicaja member. Domantas started the game in [[Starting line-up#Basketball|starting line-up]] and scored 6 points, grabbed 3 rebounds per 15 minutes of game action.<ref>[http://www.krepsinis.net/europa/unicaja-su-d-saboniu-ir-m-kuzminsku-pergale-pradejo-ispanijos-cempionata/234275 Unicaja with D.Sabonis and M.Kuzminskas started ACB league by victory] {{lt icon}}</ref> He is the youngest Unicaja player to debut in ACB (17 years, 5 months and 10 days).<ref>[http://www.krepsinis.net/europa/d-sabonis-tapo-jauniausiu-ispanijos-cempionate-zaidusiu-unicaja-zaideju/234290 D.Sabonis became the youngest player to debut in ACB as a Unicaja member.] {{lt icon}}</ref> On October 18, 2013, he debuted in the Euroleague during the game against the consecutive 2-time champions [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos Piraeus]] by scoring 2 points with a dunk and grabbing 2 rebounds per 11 minutes.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vi_qY9OIeZY Highlights: Olympiacos Piraeus-Unicaja Malaga] ''(1:35 D.Sabonis dunk)'' {{en icon}}</ref> In 2014 Sabonis was named as one of the best young European players of the year.<ref>[http://www.fibaeurope.com/coid_,qIYgqUhJ-Ue6pPZvVE7q1.articleMode_on.html FIBA EUROPE YOUNG MEN'S PLAYER OF THE YEAR 2013 FINAL VOTING] {{en icon}}</ref> His best [[Liga ACB|ACB]] game as a [[Unicaja Málaga]] member was during his eighteenth birthday on May 3, 2014, when he scored 13 points per 17 minutes with 100% shooting.<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-73138-per-18aji-gimtadieni-sabonis-suzaide-geriausias-sezono-rungtynes.html Per 18–ąjį gimtadienį Sabonis sužaidė geriausias sezono rungtynes] {{lt icon}}</ref> On May 10, 2014 Sabonis won Spain Youth Basketball League silver medal with Unicaja junior team. During final game he scored 14 points (including one three pointer) and grabbed 8 rebounds.<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-73315-sabonis-su-unicaja-ispanijos-jaunimo-pirmenybese-iskovojo-sidabro-medalius.html Sabonis su „Unicaja“ Ispanijos jaunimo pirmenybėse iškovojo sidabro medalius] {{lt icon}}</ref> On January 21, 2015, Domantas took fifth place in the [[FIBA Europe Young Men's Player of the Year Award]] contest.<ref>[http://www.fibaeurope.com/coid_VUv2HC68IKQHKl,DKDnXz1.articleMode_on.html Saric Is 2014 Young Men's POY] {{en icon}}</ref>

==International career==
{{quote box|width=21em|align=left|quote="I can say that another basketball star is growing. His father was uncommon and such human is one per 100 years. I was thinking that if Domantas will not interfere the national team, it will be good, but when he actually helps, I appreciate it very nicely." |source=— [[Jonas Kazlauskas]], describing the [[Arvydas Sabonis]] son Domantas in 2015.<ref>{{cite web|title=Kazlauskas: apie rusų norą nutraukti darbą rinktinėje ir augančią Sabonio žvaigždę|url=http://www.basketnews.lt/news-88412-kazlauskas-apie-rusu-nora-nutraukti-darba-rinktineje-ir-augancia-sabonio-zvaigzde.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=2 September 2015}}</ref>
}}
Sabonis made his international debut with the [[Lithuania men's national under-16 and under-17 basketball team|Lithuania U-16 national team]] at the [[2012 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship|2012 FIBA U-16 European Championship]], averaging 14.1 points, 14.4 rebounds and 2.4 assists per game. He grabbed a tournament-high 27 rebounds against Poland on July 27. In 2013, at 17 years of age, Domantas played for Lithuania U-18 team in [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]. He averaged 14 points, 11.4 rebounds and 1.4 assists per game<ref>[http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/cid_2bqXUaQOJwYn9c2ymJyFx0.playerID_84314.compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2013.roundID_9420.teamID_2135.html Domantas Sabonis FIBAEurope.com] {{en icon}}</ref> and was tournament leader in rebounds per game.<ref>[http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/default.asp?cid={0A5D217A-4698-4FA8-B126-60BCC13F0FEC}&pageID={B23C862E-3DEA-4074-80AD-DC9ECF5AA970}&compID={2248A846-FA78-40FF-B03C-54B460890F45}&season=2013&statCat=RT Players - Statistical Leaders (Rebounds) | U18 EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIP MEN - DIVISION A] {{en icon}}</ref> His best game was against [[Serbia national basketball team|Serbia]] when he scored 22 points, grabbed 22 rebounds and dished out 3 assists. Lithuania won the game 74-70 in [[Overtime (sports)#Basketball|OT]].<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-63814-sabonio-vedami-lietuviai-po-pratesimo-parklupde-serbus-statistika.html Domantas Sabonis leds Lithuania past Serbia after OT] {{lt icon}}</ref> In 2014, coach [[Jonas Kazlauskas]] included Sabonis into preliminary 24 players list for main [[Lithuania men's national basketball team]].<ref>[http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fe/14/wcm/news/p/nid/72845/article.html LTU - Numerous options as Kazlauskas announces list for Spain 2014] {{en icon}}</ref> In 2014, D.Sabonis played in the [[2014 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] for the second time. This time he averaged 15.9 points, 12.0 rebounds and 3.6 assists per game.<ref>[http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/cid_2bqXUaQOJwYn9c2ymJyFx0.teamID_2135.compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2014.roundID_10067.playerID_84314.html Domantas Sabonis | U18 EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIP MEN - DIVISION A] {{en icon}}</ref> He was once again one of the best tournament rebounders, this time outperformed only by [[Yankuba Sima]], who had 12.1 rebounds per game.<ref>[http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/default.asp?cid={0A5D217A-4698-4FA8-B126-60BCC13F0FEC}&pageID={B23C862E-3DEA-4074-80AD-DC9ECF5AA970}&compID={2248A846-FA78-40FF-B03C-54B460890F45}&season=2014&statCat=RT Domantas Sabonis |U18 EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIP MEN - DIVISION A]</ref> In 2015 Sabonis was once again included into the Lithuania men's national team extended candidates list.<ref>{{cite web|title=Paviešintas Lietuvos rinktinės kandidatų sąrašas|url=http://www.delfi.lt/sportas/krepsinis/paviesintas-lietuvos-rinktines-kandidatu-sarasas.d?id=67883256|website=Delfi.lt|accessdate=5 May 2015}}</ref> On July 9, 2015 he was invited to join the Lithuania men's national team training camp for the first time.<ref>{{cite web|title=J. Kazlausko sprendimas: paaiškėjo, kurie krepšininkai ruošis Europos čempionatui|url=http://www.delfi.lt/sportas/krepsinis/j-kazlausko-sprendimas-paaiskejo-kurie-krepsininkai-ruosis-europos-cempionatui.d?id=68440712|website=Delfi.lt|accessdate=9 July 2015}}</ref> On July 15, 2015 by participating in [[2015 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], Sabonis achieved the youth tournaments rebounds record by grabbing 28 of them, by doing so he also led Lithuanians to victory versus [[Ukraine national basketball team|Ukraine]] 70–57.<ref>{{cite web|title=Sabonis pagerino Europos jaunimo čempionatų rekordą|url=http://www.basketnews.lt/news-87302-sabonis-pagerino-europos-jaunimo-cempionatu-rekorda.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=15 July 2015}}</ref> Not surprisingly, he was the best tournament rebounder as in almost all previous youth competitions, with 13.2 per game this time.<ref>{{cite web|title=Players - Statistical Leaders / U20 Europe Championship Men - Division A|url=http://u20men.fibaeurope.com/en/pageID_pYajECHFHyYitKHgReBji3.compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.season_2015.roundID_11585.html|website=u20men.fibaeurope.com|accessdate=30 July 2015}}</ref> On July 29, 2015, Sabonis debuted in Lithuania men's national team during game versus [[Australia men's national basketball team|Australia]] by scoring 4 points and grabbing 7 rebounds.<ref>{{cite web|title=Kazlauskas: "Domantui dar viskas prieš akis" (video)|url=http://www.basketnews.lt/news-87691-kazlauskas-domantui-dar-viskas-pries-akis-video.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=29 July 2015}}</ref> By doing so, he immediately became the all-time youngest Lithuanian to debut in a game representing the primary men's national team.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Urbonas|first1=Donatas|title=Domantą Sabonį nuo istorinio įrašo Lietuvos krepšinyje skyrė nenumatytos aplinkybės|url=http://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/lietuva/domantas-sabonis-jauniausias-visu-laiku-lietuvos-rinktines-debiutantas-875-525349|website=24sek.lt|accessdate=2 September 2015}}</ref> Previously, the record was held by the Lithuanian basketball star [[Jonas Valančiūnas]], who did that when he was 19 years and 3 months old. Sabonis performed it being 19 years, 2 months and 26 days old.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Urbonas|first1=Donatas|title=Domantą Sabonį nuo istorinio įrašo Lietuvos krepšinyje skyrė nenumatytos aplinkybės|url=http://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/lietuva/domantas-sabonis-jauniausias-visu-laiku-lietuvos-rinktines-debiutantas-875-525349|website=24sek.lt|accessdate=2 September 2015}}</ref> In total, he averaged 6 points and 5.9 rebounds during the preparation games phase, and was the team's second best rebounder after Jonas Valančiūnas.<ref>{{cite web|title=Lietuvos rinktinės statistika: naudingiausi, rezultatyviausi ir taikliausi|url=http://www.basketnews.lt/news-88608-lietuvos-rinktines-statistika-naudingiausi-rezultatyviausi-ir-taikliausi.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=1 September 2015}}</ref> Following the solid performance at such age, Sabonis qualified into the [[Lithuania men's national basketball team]] and represented it at [[EuroBasket 2015]], and won a silver medal during his debut year.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dvejonės baigėsi – Jonas Kazlauskas paskelbė galutinį rinktinės dvyliktuką|url=http://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/lietuva/dvejones-baigesi-jonas-kazlauskas-paskelbe-galutini-rinktines-dvyliktuka-875-524785|website=24sek.lt|accessdate=1 September 2015}}</ref>

===Freshman season===
Sabonis declined a Unicaja offer of a 3-year $630,000 contract in order to play in the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Domas Sabonis a mini me of Arvydas, could he end up in Portland?|url=http://www.csnnw.com/blazers/domas-sabonis-mini-me-arvydas-could-he-end-portland|accessdate=27 July 2015}}</ref> He [[National Letter of Intent|committed]] to [[NCAA Division I]] squad [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga University]] prior to the 2014–15 season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/041714aaa.html|title=Domas Sabonis Signs Men's Basketball Letter-Of-Intent |date=April 17, 2014}}</ref><ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hguzOVKX84E Interview of Domas Sabonis] {{en icon}}</ref> On November 14, 2014, Domantas Sabonis solidly debuted by scoring 14 points, grabbing 8 rebounds, and dishing 2 assists, along with one steal and one block in 20 minutes.<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-78541-ncaa-starte-puikus-sabonio-pasirodymas-video.html NCAA starte – puikus Sabonio pasirodymas (video)] {{lt icon}}</ref> On February 3, 2015, after averaging 13 points and 11 rebounds per 26 minutes he was named [[West Coast Conference]] Player of the Week.<ref>{{cite web|title=Gonzaga's Domantas Sabonis Named WCC Men's Basketball Player of the Week|url=http://www.wccsports.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/020215aab.html|accessdate=March 3, 2015}}</ref> After a stellar regular season with Gonzaga, Sabonis was named to the All-WCC Second team, as well as to the WCC All-Freshman team.<ref name="2015 WCC Awards">{{cite web|title=WCC Announces 2015 Men's Basketball All-Conference Team|url=http://www.wccsports.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030315aab.html|accessdate=March 3, 2015}}</ref> On March 10, 2015 the Gonzaga Bulldogs defeated the [[2014–15 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU Cougars]] 91–75 and won the [[West Coast Conference|WCC Tournament]] Title for the third straight time.<ref>[http://www.gozags.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=26400&ATCLID=209951769 MBB Grabs Third Straight WCC Tournament Title] {{en icon}}</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RkIM3LFKCOE Highlights - Gonzaga vs BYU (WCC Championship 2015) - VIDEO] {{en icon}}</ref> Sabonis was one of the best players in the game with 15 points and 6 rebounds.<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-83023-solidziai-rungtyniavusio-sabonio-komanda-triumfavo-vakaru-pakrantes-konferencijoje.html Solidžiai rungtyniavusio Sabonio komanda triumfavo Vakarų pakrantės konferencijoje] {{lt icon}}</ref><ref>[http://www.krepsinis.net/naujiena/d-sabonis-svariai-prisidejo-prie-bulldogs-triumfo-vakaru-pakrantes-konferencijos-finale/248834 D.Sabonis svariai prisidėjo prie „Bulldogs“ triumfo Vakarų pakrantės konferencijos finale] {{lt icon}}</ref> During [[2015 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|March Madness]], Sabonis led Gonzaga to the Sweet 16 with 18 points and 9 rebounds.<ref>[http://www.gozags.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=26400&ATCLID=209977048 MBB Sweeps Past Iowa for Trip to Sweet 16] {{en icon}}</ref> Gonzaga beat [[2014–15 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] to make it to the Elite Eight, Gonzaga's first regional final with [[Mark Few]] as head coach and second overall. Sabonis scored 12 points and grabbed 8 rebounds during that game.<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-83645-bulldogs-su-saboniu-po-16-metu-pertraukos-pateko-tarp-8-geriausiu-ncaa-komandu-video.html „Bulldogs“ su Saboniu po 16 metų pertraukos pateko tarp 8 geriausių NCAA komandų (video)] {{lt icon}}</ref> The season ended with a loss to the future champions [[2014–15 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]] and Sabonis was named to the NCAA Tournament South Regional All-Tournament team.<ref>{{cite web|title=Notebook: Zag seniors already missed|url=http://www.spokesman.com/zags/stories/2015/mar/29/notebook-zag-seniors-already-missed/|accessdate=March 29, 2015}}</ref> In his first NCAA season, Sabonis averaged 9.7 points, along with Gonzaga team highs of 66.8% field-goal percentage and 7.1 rebounds.<ref>[http://www.basketnews.lt/news-84146-ncaa-lietuviai-nuo-debiutavusio-sabonio-iki-prestizini-universiteta-baigiancio-malduno.html NCAA lietuviai: nuo debiutavusio Sabonio iki prestižinį universitetą baigiančio Maldūno] {{lt icon}}</ref>

On April 4, 2015, Few told [[ESPN]] that Sabonis planned to return for his sophomore season at Gonzaga, adding that Sabonis never seriously considered declaring for the [[2015 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Domantas Sabonis back to Gonzaga|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/12618334/domantas-sabonis-returning-gonzaga-bulldogs||accessdate=April 4, 2015}}</ref>

===Sophomore season===
On August 13, 2015, [[ESPN]] placed Domantas Sabonis 20th in its NCAA players rankings heading for the 2015-16 season, describing him as "one of the nation's best, and edgiest, rebounders".<ref>{{cite web|title=Updated top 25 players for 2015-2016|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/insider/story/_/id/13388093/updated-look-top-25-players-college-basketball-2015-2016-season|date=August 13, 2015}}</ref>
{{quote box|width=23em|align=right|quote="No one plays harder than Gonzaga's Domantas Sabonis. The sophomore forward is a walking double-double, which could earn him third-team All-American honors."|source=— Jeff Goodman, [[ESPN]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Upperclassmen dominate Goodman's midseason All-Americans|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/insider/story/_/id/14516523/michigan-state-spartans-denzel-valentine-makes-jump-midseason-all-american-team|date=January 7, 2016}}</ref>
}}
Sabonis began his [[2015–16 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|second NCAA season]] with an outstanding career-high performance of 26 points (2FG: 12/13, FT: 2/2); he also added 7 rebounds in a 91–52 win over Northern Arizona.<ref>{{cite web|title=No. 10 MBB Cruises to 91-52 Win Over N. Arizona|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/111815aaa.html|website=GoZags.com|accessdate=19 November 2015}}</ref> On December 19, 2015, Sabonis set a new career high in points and rebounds, scoring 36 points (FG: 12/16, FT: 12/15) and adding a 16 rebounds; his team won 86–79.<ref>{{cite web|title=Sabonis Scores 36 As MBB Holds Off Tennessee 86-79|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/121915aaa.html|date=December 19, 2015}}</ref> The Zags' head coach [[Mark Few]] said that he never had seen a monster line like that for a Zag.<ref>{{cite web|title=Domantas Sabonis’ big night leads Gonzaga past Tennessee in Seattle|url=http://www.spokesman.com/stories/2015/dec/19/domantas-sabonis-leads-gonzaga-past-tennessee-in-s/|accessdate=December 19, 2015}}</ref> Two days later, Sabonis improved on another career high by dishing out 6 assists; he also scored 23 points, grabbed 8 rebounds, and led Gonzaga past the [[Pepperdine Waves men's basketball|Pepperdine Waves]] 99-73.<ref>{{cite web|title=MBB Makes 16 Threes to Beat Pepperdine 99-73|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/122115aaa.html|date=December 21, 2015}}</ref> On January 2, 2016, he was just one point shy of his scoring record with 35 points; he also added 14 rebounds, 4 assists, and 3 blocks in a thrilling come-from-behind victory in [[Overtime (sports)#Basketball|OT]] versus the [[San Francisco Dons men's basketball|San Francisco Dons]] 102–94.<ref>{{cite web|title=Sabonis, Gonzaga Rally Late to Beat SF in OT, 102-94|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/010216aaa.html|date=January 2, 2016}}</ref> On January 9, 2016, Sabonis once again improved his rebounds record by grabbing 17 rebounds, and adding 28 points, 3 steals, 3 blocks and 4 assists, his team won 85–74. After the game, the Bulldogs head coach Mark Few said: "Sabonis, none of us can take for granted the type of year he is having... Such consistency, it's amazing".<ref>{{cite web|title=Wiltjer, Sabonis Lead MBB Over Portland 85-74|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/010916aaa.html|date=January 9, 2016}}</ref> On January 21, 2016, nearly posted a [[Double (basketball)#Triple-double|triple-double]] with 17 points, 13 rebounds, and a career-high 7 assists.<ref>{{cite web|title=Gonzaga Drops Road Contest at Saint Mary's, 70-67|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/012116aaa.html|date=January 21, 2016}}</ref> Two days later, Sabonis grabbed a new career-high of 20 rebounds, as well as 12 points and 2 assists.<ref>{{cite web|title=Second-Half Surge Pushes Gonzaga past Pacific 71-61|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/012316aaa.html|date=January 23, 2016}}</ref> He was named to the 35-man midseason watchlist for the [[Naismith College Player of the Year|Naismith Trophy]] on February 11.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Payne|first1=Terrence|title=Naismith Trophy midseason list announced|url=http://www.foxsports.com/college-basketball/story/oklahoma-sooners-buddy-hield-lsu-tigers-ben-simmons-naismith-trophy-35-finalists-021116|accessdate=February 19, 2016|work=[[Fox Sports]]|date=February 11, 2016}}</ref> On March 1, 2016, he was included into the First-team All-[[West Coast Conference|WCC]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Domantas Sabonis nominuotas į pirmąją konferencijos komandą|url=http://www.basketnews.lt/news-95275-domantas-sabonis-nominuotas-i-pirmaja-konferencijos-komanda.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=1 March 2016}}</ref> Two days later, Sabonis received [[Academic All-America|CoSIDA Academic All-American]] honors.<ref>{{cite web|title=MBB’s Sabonis Named CoSIDA Academic All-American|url=http://www.gozags.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030316aac.html|website=GoZags.com|accessdate=6 March 2016}}</ref>

==NBA==
In early April 2016, several U.S. media reports indicated that he would declare himself eligible for the [[2016 NBA draft]] and would hire an [[Sports agent|agent]], marking the end of his career at Gonzaga.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/eye-on-college-basketball/25545148/gonzagas-domantas-sabonis-son-of-hall-of-famer-is-ready-for-nba-draft |title=Gonzaga's Domantas Sabonis, son of Hall of Famer, is ready for NBA Draft |first=Sam |last=Vecenie |publisher=''[[CBSSports.com]]'' |date=April 8, 2016 |accessdate=April 14, 2016}}</ref> On April 20, he signed with Jason Ranne and Greg Lawrence of [[Wasserman Media Group]] for representation in the NBA draft.<ref>{{cite web|title=D. Sabonis veržiasi į NBA: pasisamdė du agentus ir į NCAA nebegrįš|url=http://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/d-sabonis-verziasi-i-nba-pasisamde-du-agentus-ir-i-ncaa-nebegris.d?id=71037236|website=Krepsinis.lt|accessdate=20 April 2016}}</ref> Prior the draft, he rejected the offer to participate in [[NBA Draft Combine]].<ref>{{cite web|title=D. Sabonis atsisakė kvietimo į prestižinę NBA stovyklą|url=http://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/d-sabonis-atsisake-kvietimo-i-prestizine-nba-stovykla.d?id=71196212|website=Krepsinis.lt|accessdate=6 June 2016}}</ref> Instead, he participated in four teams for their pre-draft workouts: the [[Phoenix Suns]], [[Toronto Raptors]], [[Boston Celtics]] and [[Utah Jazz]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Domanto Sabonio labiausiai nori keturios NBA komandos|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-98658-domanto-sabonio-labiausiai-nori-keturios-nba-komandos.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=9 June 2016}}</ref> He is projected to be taken either late in the draft lottery range or somewhere else in the middle of the first round, although it's been said that Sabonis got a soft promise that he'd be taken somewhere in the Top 12.<ref>http://www.basketballinsiders.com/nba-am-is-derrick-rose-on-his-way-out/</ref>
